content_sections.title: Retrieve routines and details
content_sections.body_text: Use the present simple for a usual action or stable detail: ‘I run home after class. I live near the park.’ Keep private information private; use an invented address or place when practising. Notice the subject followed by the present form.

content_sections.title: Rehearse syllable boundaries
content_sections.body_text: Tap once for run and home, twice for af-ter, and twice for ad-dress. Say each part slowly, then join the parts with no added sound. Record one slow version and one normal version; count the same number of taps in both.

content_sections.title: Ask for useful help
content_sections.body_text: A: ‘Please help me write this address.’ B: ‘Yes. Say it slowly, please.’ A: ‘12 Park Road.’ B: ‘Thank you. I have it.’ The request states the task; the response starts that task. Speak both roles, then replace the invented address.

content_sections.title: Apply and verify
content_sections.body_text: Give two safe details and one usual action with run, then ask for help recording one detail. Speak, write your lines from memory, and compare them. Success: every idea is current or usual, run means fast movement on foot, the help response is relevant, and your syllable count stays stable at normal speed.
